build_boundary: standard Dockerfile stages with temporary verified module-cache injection; network dependency download not qualified
measurement_boundary: actual shared/scaling Docker Compose processes, TLS ingress, pooled PostgreSQL, browser session, restart and Tenant lifecycle; no load/SLA/HA claim
checks: shared profile provisions its Tenant through tenant-init and starts one complete process against PostgreSQL
TLS browser session, persistent Outcome and signed issuer are established
two API and two worker processes are healthy; workers expose no product routes or bootstrap/issuer secret mounts
dynamic DNS ingress routes authenticated cookie requests to both API processes
API and worker restarts preserve the browser session, issuer and exact original idempotent result
suspension refuses live API/worker leases and preserves catalog placement/version
drain, suspend, refused suspended startup, offline migrate and resume preserve session, issuer and exact original receipt
suspended deletion removes only its data schema, retains catalog tombstone and refuses identity recreation
